answered.sql: SELECT pm.name, m.name FROM Project_Managers pm JOIN Project_Managers_Methodologies pmm ON pm.id = pmm.project_manager_id JOIN Methodologies m ON pmm.methodology_id = m.methodology_id

candidates.meaning: Show methodologies used by all project managers
candidates.sql: SELECT name FROM Methodologies WHERE methodology_id IN (SELECT methodology_id FROM Project_Managers_Methodologies WHERE project_manager_id IN (SELECT id FROM Project_Managers))

candidates.meaning: Show the methodologies that are used by all project managers.
candidates.sql: SELECT name FROM Methodologies WHERE methodology_id IN (SELECT methodology_id FROM Project_Managers_Methodologies GROUP BY methodology_id HAVING COUNT(project_manager_id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Project_Managers))

candidates.meaning: List all methodologies and indicate which ones are used by at least one project manager.
Display the methodologies that each project manager uses, showing multiple rows for each project manager if they use multiple methodologies.
candidates.sql: SELECT pm.name AS project_manager, m.name AS methodology FROM Project_Managers pm JOIN Project_Managers_Methodologies pmm ON pm.id = pmm.project_manager_id JOIN Methodologies m ON m.methodology_id = pmm.methodology_id
